what: Pressure = leverage. LI(s) = swing(s) / mean swing over live balls, swing(s) = sum over 10 next-ball outcomes o of p(o|s) * |WP*(after o) - WP*(s)|.
pressure_rule: A ball is a pressure ball when it is live (win probability between 0.02 and 0.98) and LI >= 1.2073 (the 80th percentile of live balls, pooled over both innings).

engine.next_ball_model: multinomial logistic regression, 10 outcome classes; features: over band, wickets lost, required-rate band (chase), venue scoring level, competition group, impact-player rule
engine.win_probability: exact backward induction over match states, then recalibrated: WP* = logistic(a + c * logit(WP_raw))

presets.label: Chase begins
presets.rule: first ball of a chase at the median target in the reference context

presets.label: A typical pressure ball
presets.rule: the pressure ball whose leverage is the median among pressure balls

presets.label: The tightest moment
presets.rule: the highest-leverage ball in the reference context

presets.label: Late but settled
presets.rule: a non-pressure live ball with 30 or fewer balls left, median leverage

tables.encoding: gzip of a byte-shuffled little-endian uint16 buffer: all high bytes, then all low bytes

note: The pipeline's pressure score is the output of a fitted win-probability model, so it cannot be written as a short closed formula. The page evaluates it by looking up the pipeline's own value for each exact match state in the reference context.
